method.method_draft: First read the image as a 4 by 4 grid with given entries r1c1=1, r2c1=2, r2c2=1, r3c2=3, and r4c2=4. From the text, each row and column must contain exactly the numbers 1,2,3,4. Use direct constraint propagation: column 2 already has 1,3,4, so r1c2=2. Column 1 has 1 and 2, so its remaining values are 3 and 4; since row 3 already contains 3, r3c1=4, and since row 4 already contains 4, r4c1=3. Now rows 1 and 2 each need 3 and 4 in columns 3 and 4, while rows 3 and 4 each need 1 and 2 in columns 3 and 4. Choose the order of 3 and 4 in row 1/row 2 consistently so columns do not repeat: 2 choices. Independently choose the order of 1 and 2 in row 3/row 4: 2 choices. Multiply to get 2×2=4 completions.
